name: Grass Seeds
summary: Wheat seeds can turn dirt into grass and plant tall grass. Right-click dirt with seeds to get a grass block, then right-click a grass block with seeds to place tall grass on it.

vanilla_changes.change: Right-clicking a dirt block with wheat seeds converts it to a grass block.
Right-clicking a grass block with seeds places (tall) grass on it.

getting_started: Hold wheat seeds and right-click dirt.
editor_notes: Whether seeds are consumed per use is not stated in sources; verify.
